status: one generic hierarchical-selector defect identified; current Mammut simple names unaffected

blockingFindings.title: Resolve appearance selectors with the same relative descriptor paths used for contact binding
blockingFindings.evidence: applyBoardMaterials only checks finishByNodeID[entity.name]. Descriptor nodeIDs may be hierarchical paths; existing findNodeID at882 resolves name first then path relative to each instance root. Both parsers accept valid nodeIDs as finish selectors. Group/Left therefore passes validation but fails material lookup for entity named Left. Group/Attachment also misses forced neutrality when board default is wood.
blockingFindings.currentExposure: No current bundled descriptor uses slash nodeIDs; Mammut unaffected today. Defect affects newly accepted generic appearance contract.
blockingFindings.minimalFix: Apply material traversal separately to each instance root; pass that relative root through recursion. Reuse shared name-first/path-second descriptor lookup for finishByNodeID and contact-binding maps; preserve inherited finish for unnamed child meshes.
